scope: Recurring exact-revision fresh-Lean extraction, independent-review reconciliation, native adapter compilation, static contracts, reversible history and JavaScript typechecking for dependent generic checked Subtypes.

edits.current:
dependent-foundation:
    name: Dependent generic checked Subtype compiler and review contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 50
    steps:
      - name: Free hosted runner disk before checkout
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          df -h /
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          df -h /
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
      - name: Bound apt network waits
        uses: ./.github/actions/bounded-apt
        timeout-minutes: 1
      - name: Install compiler dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libgmp-dev libuv1-dev m4 pkg-config
      - name: Install dependencies and the pinned Lean compiler
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          mkdir -p build
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only 2>&1 | tee build/dependent-generic-subtype-toolchain.log
      - name: Verify dependent generic checked Subtypes
        id: acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 20
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source scripts/env.sh
          {
            node --test \
              tests/helpers/nominal-subtype-selection-tests.mjs \
              tests/helpers/nominal-subtype-native-tests.mjs \
              tests/helpers/dependent-generic-subtype-source-history-tests.mjs
            LEAN_BRIDGE_NOMINAL_SUBTYPE_SELECTION_TEST=1 \
              node --test --test-concurrency=1 \
              tests/helpers/nominal-subtype-selection-extractor-tests.mjs
            npm run typecheck
          } 2>&1 | tee build/dependent-generic-subtype.tap
      - name: Preserve complete and partial foundation records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dependent-generic-subtype-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/dependent-generic-subtype.tap
            build/dependent-generic-subtype-toolchain.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce dependent generic checked Subtype acceptance
        if: always() && steps.acceptance.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1
